decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - It is considered that this application for the two roof dormers and single storey rear extension would not have a significant adverse upon adjoining residential occupiers in terms of outlook light and privacy and would not have an adverse affect upon the character appearance of the Conservation Area.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension and roof extension to house.
